title: Grateful Dead Live at Legion Stadium on 1970-12-26
lineage: SBD > Master Reel > Cassette > Dat > CD > EAC > Samplitude v7.02 Professional > shntool > SHN

ai_review.summary: Soundboard capture of a classic 1970 show – great Easy Wind, rare Frozen Logger and Big Railroad Blues shine, though the tape runs a touch slow.
ai_review.review: The performance is praised for its energetic Easy Wind, a standout Frozen Logger, and a monster Big Railroad Blues, with several reviewers calling it one of their favorite shows from ’70. The soundboard source is generally clear, but listeners note a slight slowdown and occasional minor glitches that don’t detract from the overall vibe.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high reviewer scores (mostly 4‑5 stars) highlight strong musical moments; recording issues are mentioned but are minor, leading to an overall strong rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear soundboard mix with a few problems – noticeable tape slowdown and occasional muddiness, but the instruments remain well‑balanced and audible.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set flows with a relaxed, funky feel; Easy Wind and the rare Frozen Logger provide high points while the overall pacing is described as dynamic and enjoyable.

band_member_comments.Bob: Bob Weir is highlighted on Easy Wind – his playing is ‘ON’ and clearly heard during the jam.
